---
title: "R function reference"
description: "Every R export grouped by purpose."
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{R function reference}
  %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

**Install:** `install.packages("a11yviz", repos = c("https://mshin77.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))`

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
library(a11yviz)

groups <- list(
  list(title = "ggplot2 transforms",
       desc  = "Composable additions to a ggplot chain.",
       names = c("theme_a11y",
                 "scale_color_a11y",      "scale_fill_a11y",
                 "scale_color_a11y_div",  "scale_fill_a11y_div",
                 "scale_color_a11y_seq",  "scale_fill_a11y_seq")),
  list(title = "plotly transforms",
       desc  = "Layout and styling for plotly figures.",
       names = c("a11y_layout", "a11y_ggplotly")),
  list(title = "Alt text",
       desc  = "Attach, scaffold, or LLM-draft screen-reader descriptions.",
       names = c("a11y_alt_text", "a11y_alt_template", "a11y_describe")),
  list(title = "Palettes",
       desc  = "Discrete, diverging, and sequential palettes with WCAG metadata.",
       names = c("a11y_palette", "a11y_palette_div", "a11y_palette_seq",
                 "a11y_palette_info", "a11y_palette_list", "a11y_show_palette")),
  list(title = "Audits and checks",
       desc  = "Multi-criterion figure audit, rubric, and single-aspect checks.",
       names = c("a11y_audit", "a11y_audit_chart", "a11y_audit_doc",
                 "a11y_audit_actionable", "a11y_audit_summary", "a11y_rubric",
                 "a11y_check_alt_text", "a11y_check_headings",
                 "a11y_check_overlap", "a11y_check_palette",
                 "a11y_check_palette_size", "a11y_check_readability",
                 "a11y_check_separability", "a11y_check_tabindex",
                 "a11y_plotly_sequences")),
  list(title = "Shiny and HTML helpers",
       desc  = "ARIA labels and live-region announcements for Shiny UI.",
       names = c("a11y_aria_label", "a11y_announce")),
  list(title = "Wrappers and utilities",
       desc  = "One-shot helpers and resource paths.",
       names = c("make_a11y", "a11y_minimum", "a11y_alpha_presets",
                 "a11y_text_spacing_ratios", "a11y_css", "a11y_css_contents",
                 "a11y_wcag_url", "run_app"))
)

rd_titles <- local({
  db <- tools::Rd_db("a11yviz")
  out <- character()
  for (rd in db) {
    tags    <- vapply(rd, attr, character(1), "Rd_tag")
    aliases <- vapply(rd[tags == "\\alias"],
                      function(x) trimws(paste(unlist(x), collapse = "")),
                      character(1))
    title_text <- trimws(paste(unlist(rd[tags == "\\title"][[1]]),
                               collapse = ""))
    out[aliases] <- title_text
  }
  out
})

format_sig <- function(name) {
  fn   <- get(name, envir = asNamespace("a11yviz"))
  args <- formals(fn)
  parts <- vapply(seq_along(args), function(i) {
    nm  <- names(args)[i]
    rhs <- paste(deparse(args[[i]], width.cutoff = 500L), collapse = "")
    if (rhs == "") nm else paste0(nm, " = ", rhs)
  }, character(1))
  paste0("(", paste(parts, collapse = ", "), ")")
}

for (g in groups) {
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n%s\n\n| Function | Description |\n|---|---|\n",
              g$title, g$desc))
  for (nm in g$names) {
    title <- if (nm %in% names(rd_titles)) unname(rd_titles[nm]) else ""
    cat(sprintf("| `%s%s` | %s |\n", nm, format_sig(nm), title))
  }
}
```
